plays.desc_en: Tracking Oner and Keria via wards, G2 collapses with numbers. Hostile Takeover hits only Keria, Chain of Corruption follows, and Hans Sama (Varus) kills Peyz (Xayah) against the wall for a double kill.
plays.quote: THE HOSTILE TAKEOVER ONLY HITTING ... PAY IS GETTING CHASED OUT. ... A DOUBLE FOR THE BARS.

plays.desc_ko: 열세 상황에서 Doran이 메가 변신에 가까운 상태로 버티고 Faker가 체력 1/3의 Hans Sama에게 진입했으나, SkewMond의 Impact에 체력 10까지 몰려 정글로 쫓기다 SkewMond에게 잡힘.
plays.desc_en: With T1 behind, Doran (Gnar) holds near Mega form as Faker (Sylas) dives a third-HP Hans Sama (Varus), but SkewMond's (Skarner) Impact drops him to 10 HP and SkewMond hunts him down in the jungle.
plays.quote: FAKER DIVES IN ... as Faker now 10 HP chased out of the ... FINDS HIM. Nicely done by G2 again.

plays.desc_ko: 회고/리플레이: Caps가 은신 진입 후 E-플래시로 Peyz(추정)를 기습해 솔로킬; Peyz는 플래시를 소모. 원래 발생 시점은 해설로 특정 불가(직전 31:26-32:46 교전 중일 가능성).
plays.desc_en: In replay, Caps (Aurora) enters stealth and E-Flashes onto Peyz (Xayah, likely) for a solo kill after Peyz burns Flash; the exact timing isn't clear from commentary.
plays.quote: SOLO KILL ONTO CAPS. ... So Pace did spend his flash ... Yep, just caught him with the E flash.

plays.desc_ko: T1이 바론을 외치는 사이 Oner가 화염 드래곤(T1의 세 번째)을 시작; 해설은 T1이 영혼 포인트에 도달한다고 언급.
plays.desc_en: While T1 calls Baron, Oner (Lee Sin) starts the Infernal Drake, T1's third, bringing them to soul point.
plays.quote: actually at the infernal right now. ... Drake has been begun by Owner would be ... to soul point.

plays.desc_ko: Faker가 훔친 Impale을 쓰고 Keria가 후열로 The Quickness 진입, Peyz가 Hans Sama를 처치한 것을 계기로 T1이 교전을 뒤집음. Faker가 Labrov를 처치, Peyz가 BB 추격을 버티며 추가 킬, Caps만 생존.
plays.desc_en: Faker (Sylas) uses a stolen Impale, Keria (Rakan) dives the backline with The Quickness, and Peyz (Xayah) kills Hans Sama (Varus) to turn the fight. Faker kills Labrov and Peyz survives BB's chase for another kill, leaving only Caps alive.
plays.quote: uses the hijack impale ... BUT PACE GETS THE KILL. ... T1 WIN OUT

plays.desc_ko: G2 대응: Labrov의 Hostile Takeover가 Faker와 Doran에게 적중, Hans Sama가 Doran을 거의 잡을 뻔했으나 실패. BrokenBlade가 Peyz를 쫓았지만 Steel Tempest를 제때 맞히지 못함, Caps는 장막 넘어 생존.
plays.desc_en: Labrov's (Renata Glasc) Hostile Takeover hits Faker and Doran and Hans Sama (Varus) nearly kills Doran but fails. BrokenBlade (Yasuo) chases Peyz but can't land Steel Tempest in time, and Caps (Aurora) survives over the veil.
plays.quote: TAKE OVER CATCHES ONTO FAKER AND ... HE ALMOST TAKES OUT DOR ... getting chased out by BB but he can't

plays.desc_ko: 귀환하려는 Caps를 Keria와 Faker가 추격했으나 결국 대시로 빠져나옴; 해설은 귀환을 지연시켰다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: Keria (Rakan) and Faker (Sylas) chase a recalling Caps (Aurora), who eventually dashes out, but they delay his recall.
plays.quote: Caps recalling. Keer and ... have to dash out. ... They do delay the recalls though

plays.desc_ko: 귀환 지연을 이용해 T1이 여러 라인을 밀고 Doran이 탑을 밀어붙임; 해설은 미드 포탑을 가져갈 것이라 언급.
plays.desc_en: Using the delayed recall, T1 pushes multiple lanes with Doran (Gnar) shoving top, and is expected to take the mid tower.
plays.quote: they're going to get mid lane ... They're pushing in multiple ... Doran shoving up top

plays.desc_ko: Keria의 The Quickness와 함께 Oner가 SkewMond를 벽 너머로 차서 포탑 쪽 다이브; 해설은 이후 이를 Oner의 실수로 평가.
plays.desc_en: With Keria's (Rakan) The Quickness, Oner (Lee Sin) kicks SkewMond (Skarner) over the wall for a tower dive, later judged a mistake.
plays.quote: Quickness out of carrier. ... KICKED ACROSS THE WALL BY OWNER. ... GETS THE KILL. NO, HE DOESN'T.

plays.desc_ko: 회고: Oner 다이브~T1 4대1 교환 교전 당시 Caps가 TP 없이 탑 라인을 밀고 있어 합류하지 못함.
plays.desc_en: During Oner's dive and the following fight, Caps (Aurora) was pushing top without Teleport and couldn't join.
plays.quote: no TP on Caps ... and Caps is pushing top lane.

plays.desc_ko: G2가 이중 Impale과 Hostile Takeover로 T1을 포탑 아래로 끌어당겨 반격; Oner가 포탑 공격을 맞음. 해설은 처음엔 T1에 재앙처럼 보였다고 언급.
plays.desc_en: G2 drags T1 under tower with a double Impale and Hostile Takeover, and Oner (Lee Sin) takes tower shots; it initially looks disastrous for T1.
plays.quote: AND NOW WITH A DOUBLE IMPALED ABOVE ... THEY'LL PULL THEM BACK UNDERNEATH THE ... OWNER TAKES A TOWER SHOT.

plays.desc_ko: T1 전원이 합류해 너무 깊이 들어온 SkewMond를 잡고 Keria가 Hans Sama를 추격, BrokenBlade를 Gnar가 벽에 박는 등 4대1 교환으로 마무리. Caps는 TP 없이 탑을 밀고 있어 합류 못함.
plays.desc_en: T1 collapses to kill an overextended SkewMond (Skarner), Keria (Rakan) chases Hans Sama, and Doran (Gnar) slams BrokenBlade into a wall for a four-for-one trade, while Caps was pushing top without Teleport.
plays.quote: NOW SKUMAN IS A LITTLE BIT TOO DEEP ... collapse continues. ... BLADE SLAMMED IN BY THE N T1.

plays.desc_ko: Keria가 들어갔다 빠지고 SkewMond가 강타를 쓰는 사이 Faker의 훔친 Impale로 SkewMond를 끌어오고 Peyz가 녹임. Labrov도 도주 실패, T1 5인이 추격해 Hans Sama까지 처치.
plays.desc_en: As Keria (Rakan) goes in and out and SkewMond (Skarner) uses Smite, Faker's (Sylas) stolen Impale drags SkewMond in for Peyz (Xayah) to melt. Labrov fails to escape and T1 chases down Hans Sama too.
plays.quote: Impale used by Faker. ... PAZ JUST RIPS THROUGH SKUMAN. ... CAN'T ESCAPE. T1 AS A FIVEMAN SQUAD JUST

plays.desc_ko: 교전 승리 후 T1이 넥서스로 진격해 게임 승리(시리즈 연장).
plays.desc_en: After winning the fight, T1 marches to the Nexus and wins the game, extending the series.
plays.quote: NO SWEEP TODAY. ... And Faker smiling as they march ... We have got ourselves a series.
